Life sciences organizations engage Viltis when they need experienced expertise to support critical initiatives across regulatory, quality, clinical, engineering, and scientific functions. We work with companies at different stages of growth and complexity, providing flexible engagement models aligned with business needs.

Our approach emphasizes clarity, responsiveness, and alignment with how regulated organizations actually operate. Whether supporting a defined initiative or strengthening long-term capabilities, we focus on practical execution and professional accountability.

Organizations work with Viltis through three primary engagement models: strategic consulting, dynamic staff augmentation, and full-time expert recruitment.

Strategic consulting engagements support organizations navigating complex challenges, inflection points, or periods of change. These engagements are typically project-based and focused on delivering clear analysis, recommendations, and execution support.

Strategic consulting is often used when organizations require objective perspective, specialized expertise, or additional leadership capacity to address high-impact initiatives.

Common strategic consulting engagements include:

Regulatory, quality, or clinical strategy development

Inspection readiness and remediation planning

Program and portfolio assessments

Scientific, technical, or operational due diligence

Process and governance optimization

Strategic consulting engagements are scoped to align with defined objectives, timelines, and outcomes, providing organizations with focused support where it matters most.

Dynamic Staff Augmentation

Dynamic staff augmentation provides organizations with flexible access to experienced professionals who can integrate into existing teams and workflows. This model supports periods of increased workload, specialized needs, or temporary resource gaps.

Staff augmentation engagements are designed to maintain continuity and momentum without requiring long-term hiring commitments. Professionals are aligned to the organization’s processes, systems, and expectations from day one.

Dynamic staff augmentation is commonly used to support:

Regulatory, quality, or clinical execution

Inspection preparation and response

Submission or launch activities

Study execution and operational support

Engineering, validation, or technical initiatives

This engagement model allows organizations to scale expertise up or down as priorities evolve.

Full-Time Expert Recruitment

Full-time expert recruitment supports organizations seeking to build or strengthen internal teams with experienced professionals. These engagements focus on identifying candidates with the technical expertise, leadership capability, and cultural fit required for long-term success.

Recruitment efforts are tailored to the specific role, organizational context, and regulatory environment. Emphasis is placed on identifying professionals who can operate independently, collaborate cross-functionally, and contribute meaningfully from the outset.

Full-time recruitment is commonly used for roles across:

Regulatory affairs and regulatory operations

Quality assurance and compliance leadership

Clinical operations and development

Engineering, validation, and technical operations

Scientific and CMC functions

This model supports sustainable team growth and long-term capability building.

How Organizations Engage with Viltis

Engagements with Viltis typically begin with a discussion to understand organizational needs, priorities, and constraints. From there, an appropriate engagement model is identified based on scope, urgency, and desired outcomes.

Organizations value Viltis for:

Practical, experience-driven expertise

Flexibility across engagement models

Alignment with regulated industry expectations

Clear communication and accountability

Our goal is to support organizations in achieving progress with confidence, clarity, and continuity.

Where does your business need more support? We offer a broad range of solutions that can be customized to your business needs. Send us a message today!
